entries.label: eDamage Keys!CH5
entries.reason: Super crit chance on the keys tab. Read on 2026-08-23: it is eDamage!DL5's formula minus $BM$20 plus BR5*2%, so it swaps the account's vault percentage for the keys BAND's. eDamage carries no vault term for this stat at all, which is why the port needs the accumulated k*2% only on this band -- modelled as flatSuperCritChanceBonus in effective-paths-edamage-plan.ts

entries.label: eDamage Keys!CU5
entries.reason: Max Rend Armor Multiplier on the keys tab: `=IF($AX$19="Attack Disso", 1, IF($AL$69, ($BF$22+$AM$16)*($BK$22), 1))`. Read on 2026-08-23. It omits the ASSIST substat that eDamage!DZ5 includes, and that single omission was the last systematic difference between the two tabs' bases -- 0.478% on Other Mults

entries.label: eDamage Keys!CY5
entries.reason: The keys tab's Spotlight column, which reads $BM$39 (the ultimate weapon vault). Read on 2026-08-22. Every keys candidate column reuses it as `SL, $CY5` from the BASE row, so the sheet does not refresh Spotlight when it prices a vault purchase -- modelled as the spotlightVaultPct shadow

entries.label: eDamage Keys!DD5
entries.reason: The keys tab's Poison Swamp, which is `='eDamage Stone'!DW5` — it takes the STONE tab's value, stone rebuild and all, where every other weapon in its UW total is its own. Read on the live sheet; the port reproduces it via EffectiveDamageShadow.poisonSwampOverride.

entries.label: eDamage Keys!DL5
entries.reason: The Critical Chance keys candidate. Read on 2026-08-22: it bumps TWO inputs, `CC, CF5+1%` and `SCC, CH5+1%`, where the Super Crit Chance column one over bumps only `SCC, CH5+2%`. Reproduced as a flatSuperCritChanceBonus shadow rather than judged

entries.label: eDamage Keys!DW5
entries.reason: The vault Damage node's ROI column. Read on 2026-08-22: `Now, 1+5%*BO5 · Next, 1+5%*(BO5+1) · Factor, Next/Now-1 · Cost, DW$2*POW(2,BO5)` -- the one keys candidate priced on a local ladder; the other ten use (candidate/$DI5-1). Modelled as the `keys.damage` relativeGain in effective-paths-edamage-plan.ts

entries.reason: Cited in effective-paths-*.ts; not yet a graph node — explicit unknown (not a silent gap). The ILM cooldown DISPLAY cell, =IF(BH37, MAX(37, BK37 + AM41 + AR41), ). entries.label: eDamage!BM39
entries.reason: The ultimate weapon damage VAULT percentage. Read on 2026-08-22: it is the second factor of eDamage!CX6, and `eDamage Keys!BY5` is the same cell over 5% as a level. Both readings are now used -- effective-paths-edamage-compute.ts divides CX6 by (1+this) so the captured product can be re-expressed at whatever level the keys planner has reached, which is what lets a vault purchase move the ultimate weapon half at all
